$comment: Accepted vulnerability findings (p7-supply-chain, docs/security/dependency-policy.md §5). Every entry: id (advisory id or alias), optional package, reason (why not exploitable here / why no fix), owner, expires (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days ahead). Expired entries fail the gate.

entries.reason: moderate: CPU denial of service through globparts amplification of a crafted pattern. No 10.x fix exists (fixed in 11.0.1). Workspace: dev-only, pulled in by eslint 10.12.0 and typescript-eslint 8.71.2 with patterns from our own lint config. Fix: eslint 10.15.0 + typescript-eslint >= 8.73.0 (minimatch 11; needs a full lint run). The pi runtime no longer carries it (pi-coding-agent 1.6.0 uses minimatch 11.0.3).
